verdict.rationale: SAM.gov's Entity Management API documents a dedicated system-to-system channel. Users create a System Account through the "System Accounts" widget and get it approved, and API keys are tied to SAM.gov accounts. The public page also covers individual vs. system accounts, rate limits, bulk extract, and tiered Public/FOUO/Sensitive access by account sensitivity level. missing for 10: details of the system-account approval criteria and timeline, evidence of write/transactional (not just retrieval) machine channels, independent or hands-on corroboration of the enrollment path.
